name: HOGE streaming 1024-point NTT wrapper lint
description: Streaming 32-lane HOGE forward NTT over the 64-bit TFHEpp/cuHEpp modulus.

parameters.stream_cycles_note: Extraction-side nominal input burst; this lint-only task does not score output burst length.

reference.operation: cuHEpp::NTT<10, 5> followed by forward twist and InvPow2(10) field multiplication

observable_contract.transaction: 32 accepted input cycles, valid output within 4000 cycles, then exactly 32 valid output cycles.
observable_contract.input_order: input lane l at cycle c carries coefficient c * 32 + l
observable_contract.output_order: output lane l at cycle c carries coefficient c * 32 + l
observable_contract.ready: io_ready should be high when an input cycle is accepted
io_ready must remain high for the 32 input cycles

score.primary: minimize cycles from final input to first valid output
